en: A black-and-white photograph of a mid-20th-century cargo ship sailing on calm waters. The ship shows classic features of post-war European coastal freighters, with two masts, a forward bridge, and smokestack. The name 'BREMEN KAPPEL' is visible on the bow, along with another word that looks like 'KAPPEL' on the stern. No famous landmarks or city skylines are visible; the focus is solely on the vessel.
